widgets_values: Move the camera from the right to a three-quarter view position to make the full body of the character visible. When the character is standing, both arms are slightly lowered and close to the thighs, maintaining balance. The background is pure white.

Move the camera from the left to the side view (side profile) position to make the full body of the character visible, with bare feet. When the character is standing, both arms are slightly lowered and close to the thighs, maintaining balance. The background is pure white.

Move the camera to the back position so that the full body of the character, including the feet, is visible. When the character is standing, the arms are slightly lowered and close to the thighs, maintaining balanced symmetry on both sides of the body. The back is pure white.

Move the camera to the front position to make the full body of the character, including the feet, visible. When the character is standing, the arms are slightly lowered and close to the thighs, maintaining even balance on both sides of the body. The back is pure white.
